test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘no substitution required’.

Bonaparte, unlike Hoche, was not (eagerly to embark in) a serious Irish expedition.
solution:
The correct answer is "**eager to embark on**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options:
 
• **In option 1, the correct preposition "to" is used after the word "eager."**
 
 
• **Also, the phrase "embark on" is used correctly which means to begin a journey or mission by boarding a ship or aircraft. **(शुरू करना)
 
• **Thus, option 1 is correct.**
 
 
 
• Therefore, the sentence should read: "Bonaparte, unlike Hoche, was not eager to embark on __a serious Irish expedition."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In option 3, "eagerest to embarked on" is incorrect because "eagerest" is not a word in standard English, and the tense of the verb is also incorrect.
 
• In option 4, "eager into embark in" is incorrect because it uses the incorrect preposition "into" and also has a tense error.
